name: Illini Summer Academies
org: Illinois 4-H and University of Illinois Extension
what_you_do: Live in a campus dorm for a week and take a hands-on academy led by university departments. Topics change each year. The 2026 list included digital farming, and breeding and genes.
who_can_apply: High school students. The page does not list an age range or require 4-H membership.
pay_detail: 2027 base fee is $500, plus an academy fee, often $0 to $250. In 2026 the late base fee was $550. Campus parking was $60 for the week. Need-based Trailblazer scholarships were offered.
duration: About 4 days, Sunday to Thursday (June 20 to 24, 2027)
deadline_text: Registration opens Feb 1, 2027. The academy list is posted in early January 2027. No closing date is posted. In 2026, early registration ran Feb 9 to Mar 1 and the deadline was Apr 17.
how_to_apply: Sign up online through ZSuite (Illinois 4-H event sign-up) when it opens. Ask for the Trailblazer scholarship in the same sign-up.
notes: Stay at Bousfield Hall, 1214 S. First St., Champaign. Refunds in 2026 had to be requested in writing by May 15. Questions: illinois4H@illinois.edu or 217-333-0910.
